sources.prompt: A wide printed wall mural for a family science and astronomy store: a beautiful star chart of the northern night sky. Deep navy-blue background, hundreds of small white and pale-gold stars of varied brightness, the constellations drawn as thin gold lines joining their stars (the Big Dipper, Cassiopeia, Cygnus, Orion, Lyra, Draco, Perseus), a soft milky band of the Milky Way crossing diagonally, a faint pale-blue celestial coordinate grid of arcs and meridians, a thin gold horizon ring along the lower edge with tiny tick marks, and a row of small moon-phase discs along the bottom margin. Flat graphic artwork viewed straight on, filling the entire image edge to edge: no frame, no wall, no room, no people, no perspective, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. Mid-century screen-print style with a lightly aged matte paper texture. Landscape 3:2.

Three separate vintage advertising posters for a science discovery toy store, placed side by side in one image with equal narrow plain off-white gutters between them; each poster is a tall portrait panel filling its third of the image from top to bottom, all three the same size, shown straight on. Poster 1: a boxed children's chemistry set with test tubes in a rack, round flasks and bright bubbling green, blue and orange liquids, headline CHEMISTRY SET. Poster 2: a crystal-growing kit, glowing purple and sky-blue crystal geodes and a glass jar of growing crystals, headline GROW CRYSTALS. Poster 3: a build-your-own robot kit, a friendly retro tin robot surrounded by gears, bolts and a screwdriver, headline BUILD A ROBOT. Mid-century screen-print style in a deep navy blue, gold and white palette with bright accent colours, lightly aged matte paper. Flat graphic art: no frames, no wall, no room, no people photographed, no perspective, no real brand names or logos. Landscape 3:2.

A classroom wall chart in the style of a periodic table of the elements, shown straight on and filling the entire image edge to edge. An off-white background with a deep navy title band across the top reading PERIODIC TABLE in bold white capitals. Below it a grid of square tiles in the classic periodic-table silhouette: two tall columns on the left, a lower block of ten columns in the middle, six tall columns on the right, and two separate rows of tiles underneath. Each tile shows one large one- or two-letter element symbol and a small number above it, colour-coded in soft families: coral red, orange, sunflower yellow, leaf green, teal, sky blue and violet. Clean flat print graphic, vintage school-chart style, lightly aged matte paper. No frame, no wall, no room, no people, no perspective, no logos. Landscape 3:2.
